lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: There is a party at the prince's house, but Cinderella cannot go.
lines.chinese: 王子家有一个派对，但灰姑娘不能去。

lines.speaker: Sister
lines.chinese: 灰姑娘，我的手套在哪里？

lines.speaker: Fairy
lines.english: Why are you so sad, dear?
lines.chinese: 亲爱的，你为什么这么伤心？

lines.speaker: Cinderella
lines.english: Because I can't go to the party.
lines.chinese: 因为我不能去参加聚会。

lines.speaker: Cinderella
lines.english: Because I don't have any nice clothes or shoes.
lines.chinese: 因为我没有任何好看的衣服或鞋子。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Cinderella puts on the new clothes and shoes.
lines.chinese: 灰姑娘穿上了新衣服和鞋子。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Cinderella has a good time at the party.
lines.chinese: 灰姑娘在聚会上玩得很开心。

lines.speaker: Cinderella
lines.english: Sorry, I have to go now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: The prince visits every house. Many girls try on the shoe, but it does not fit. Finally, Cinderella tries it on.
lines.chinese: 王子拜访了每一栋房子。很多女孩试穿了这只鞋，但是都不合脚。最后，灰姑娘试穿了它。
